input.allowed_context: retrieved evidence excerpts with stable evidence IDs

evidence_facts.description: Readable factual statements tied to one or more supplied evidence IDs.
evidence_facts.validation: Every evidence_id must exist in the input. Statements without evidence IDs are rejected.

model_assessment.label: Qwen model assessment - probabilistic interpretation, not a verified fact
model_assessment.display: Show directly below evidence facts in plain language with the confidence value and linked basis evidence.

uncertainties.description: Missing context, alternative explanations or limits of the available evidence.
uncertainties.display: Always visible below the model assessment.

storage.model_assessment: derived model output, never stored as a case fact without analyst review
